demiplane.native: Each native card, Core entry, book placement and class-access row is copied unchanged below. All five are rank 8, Action, range 120 ft, V/S/F, base 21 RP, minimum actual class level 15. Demiplane has two book placements but its actual grants remain Conjuration. demiplane.preflight: Use an actually acquired and prepared matrix or an exact class permission. Check remaining Action, usable voice, free gesturing hand and actual focus, rank/RP, target identity, actual range and unobstructed line of effect. A known invalid declaration is rejected before payment. Missing authoritative physical/source prerequisites put the dependent case on hold; a held test is not a successful or paid cast. A lawful declaration defeated only by hidden facts spends its committed costs and produces no diagnostic locating or classifying the hidden fact. Revalidate each component at effect resolution. No retargeting or refund on failure.
demiplane.commit: Commit RP, components, source-history and concentration before interruption/save. Cost is 21 plus the exact pre-cast Dissonance surcharge and printed extras only. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); +1 at limit, +2 at limit+3, ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. First distinct actual Wizard prepared family gives zero BASE strain only; otherwise rank8 base strain is 2. Consecutive same-family Refrain adds 1/2/3 capped at3, idle turns do not reset it. No class perk is assumed without acquisition. An interrupted or resisted cast retains costs and never restores displaced concentration. Exact legal Counterspell/Dispel sources keep their own ranks/costs/checks; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/check INT+PB versus18 for rank8, not rank5 Greater Dispel.
demiplane.timing: Use actual elapsed seconds; generated spaces have 1:1 time. An expiry at timestamp t occurs before a newly beginning action at t; already committed atomic crossings finish before an external closure event can settle them. Ordinary Ready commits at preparation, uses held concentration, releases once with a remaining Reaction after its completed trigger, and expires at the next own regular START. Release does not pay/cast/update cadence again; effect deadlines begin on release. A continuing effect retains concentration normally after release. No extra regular START, recharge, rest, recovery, Refrain reset, Hunt pause or resource refresh is created by moving planes.
demiplane.transport: Creation of a room/cell is not itself body travel. Door creation is a connection; its use is physical planar crossing. Maze, Seal of Banishment and Gloom Bind admissions are planar displacement, not teleportation. Record ACCEPT versus RESIST separately from save result. Voluntary or forced travel restrictions use their exact predicates, not a generic planar tag. Every creature is separate from gear, including carried unconscious allies, mounts and summons. Check whole-body geometry and actual custody for each. No splitting, duplicating inventories, body-as-cargo target-cap bypass or unprovided portal provider. Record current plane, actual travel provenance, origin anchor and source-character identity separately from native realm, which may remain unknown.
demiplane.hardControl: Maze, each Seal of Banishment child and Gloom Bind count as encounter-removal/hard denial and require the shared source-character/target/encounter gate across all that source character’s spells, classes and companions. Spend the gate only on actual establishment, not a resisted or preflight-rejected cast. Prior expenditure or a proved immunity prevents only the applicable control; no new target or refund. No nesting or refresh bypass. Record actual save ability, bonus, DC, die and any chosen lawful reaction/reroll; no generic monster save profile is invented.
demiplane.closureExtension: NEW P5-CLOSE extension applies ONLY to true Demiplane room removal, Maze termination and Seal of Banishment child termination. It explicitly reuses BAN-CLOSE-03, BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03 and BAN-CONFLICT-04: end the source first, settle every extant identity exactly once to its fixed origin plane/anchor (secondary occupants project their local offset onto the recorded entry/creation anchor), ignore ONLY transport-prevention at the terminal endpoints. Try full body at anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral order (south, west, east, north, then SW, SE, NW, NE on the declared grid). Never pass a wall/occupied space or search farther. If none fits, retain a logical-anchor placementConflict with no fabricated footprint, support, falling, movement or new actions; independently legal actions and clocks continue. Normalize only when obstruction is actually removed or lawful relocation resolves it. Loose items retain pending placement/custody, never disappear. Source has ended even while conflict remains. This exception does not permit voluntary entry, internal escape, new portal crossings or Gloom release and does not broaden the pre-existing BAN interfaces.
demiplane.custody: Every item has one stable identity, provenance, current holder or ground location, weight, Load and independent deadline. Living bodies, corpses and source-ended absent entities are distinct. Mandatory anatomy/source endings happen first; never delay an expiry to preserve a convenient shape or manufacture a corpse. A generated space supplies only expressly authored floor/boundaries/light/respiration support; no harvestable matter, permanent supplies, inhabitants, treasure, immunity, protected rest, native status, soul rule or automatic Extraction. Preserve cargo danger, taint, claims and Hunt records. Once initiated, Hunt death is normally final except the owner’s extremely rare Divine/Abyssal exception; none of these spells grants that exception.
demiplane.qualification: Static proposed authorship and data-only fixtures are not game execution or observed campaign results. Real actor acquisition, creature profiles, destination geometry, native/cosmology facts, environmental needs and equipment not established by a source remain explicit whole-case/branch holds. No runtime, human-play, balance, cosmology or release approval. All closed feat335, completed16/72 and applied spell cohorts remain closed.

commonRules.native: Each native card, Core entry, book placement and class-access row is copied unchanged below. All five are rank 8, Action, range 120 ft, V/S/F, base 21 RP, minimum actual class level 15. Demiplane has two book placements but its actual grants remain Conjuration. Maze uses Wizard Illusion versus Cleric/Mage Universal. Do not create access from a school heading. Original Instantaneous fields remain evidence even where a NEW ongoing component is selected. Gloom Bind retains Core Until dispelled and both conflicting destination names.
commonRules.preflight: Use an actually acquired and prepared matrix or an exact class permission. Check remaining Action, usable voice, free gesturing hand and actual focus, rank/RP, target identity, actual range and unobstructed line of effect. A known invalid declaration is rejected before payment. Missing authoritative physical/source prerequisites put the dependent case on hold; a held test is not a successful or paid cast. A lawful declaration defeated only by hidden facts spends its committed costs and produces no diagnostic locating or classifying the hidden fact. Revalidate each component at effect resolution. No retargeting or refund on failure.
commonRules.commit: Commit RP, components, source-history and concentration before interruption/save. Cost is 21 plus the exact pre-cast Dissonance surcharge and printed extras only. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); +1 at limit, +2 at limit+3, ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. First distinct actual Wizard prepared family gives zero BASE strain only; otherwise rank8 base strain is 2. Consecutive same-family Refrain adds 1/2/3 capped at3, idle turns do not reset it. No class perk is assumed without acquisition. An interrupted or resisted cast retains costs and never restores displaced concentration. Exact legal Counterspell/Dispel sources keep their own ranks/costs/checks; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/check INT+PB versus18 for rank8, not rank5 Greater Dispel.
commonRules.timing: Use actual elapsed seconds; generated spaces have 1:1 time. An expiry at timestamp t occurs before a newly beginning action at t; already committed atomic crossings finish before an external closure event can settle them. Ordinary Ready commits at preparation, uses held concentration, releases once with a remaining Reaction after its completed trigger, and expires at the next own regular START. Release does not pay/cast/update cadence again; effect deadlines begin on release. A continuing effect retains concentration normally after release. No extra regular START, recharge, rest, recovery, Refrain reset, Hunt pause or resource refresh is created by moving planes.
commonRules.transport: Creation of a room/cell is not itself body travel. Door creation is a connection; its use is physical planar crossing. Maze, Seal of Banishment and Gloom Bind admissions are planar displacement, not teleportation. Record ACCEPT versus RESIST separately from save result. Voluntary or forced travel restrictions use their exact predicates, not a generic planar tag. Every creature is separate from gear, including carried unconscious allies, mounts and summons. Check whole-body geometry and actual custody for each. No splitting, duplicating inventories, body-as-cargo target-cap bypass or unprovided portal provider. Record current plane, actual travel provenance, origin anchor and source-character identity separately from native realm, which may remain unknown.
commonRules.hardControl: Maze, each Seal of Banishment child and Gloom Bind count as encounter-removal/hard denial and require the shared source-character/target/encounter gate across all that source character’s spells, classes and companions. Spend the gate only on actual establishment, not a resisted or preflight-rejected cast. Prior expenditure or a proved immunity prevents only the applicable control; no new target or refund. No nesting or refresh bypass. Record actual save ability, bonus, DC, die and any chosen lawful reaction/reroll; no generic monster save profile is invented.
commonRules.closureExtension: NEW P5-CLOSE extension applies ONLY to true Demiplane room removal, Maze termination and Seal of Banishment child termination. It explicitly reuses BAN-CLOSE-03, BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03 and BAN-CONFLICT-04: end the source first, settle every extant identity exactly once to its fixed origin plane/anchor (secondary occupants project their local offset onto the recorded entry/creation anchor), ignore ONLY transport-prevention at the terminal endpoints. Try full body at anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral order (south, west, east, north, then SW, SE, NW, NE on the declared grid). Never pass a wall/occupied space or search farther. If none fits, retain a logical-anchor placementConflict with no fabricated footprint, support, falling, movement or new actions; independently legal actions and clocks continue. Normalize only when obstruction is actually removed or lawful relocation resolves it. Loose items retain pending placement/custody, never disappear. Source has ended even while conflict remains. This exception does not permit voluntary entry, internal escape, new portal crossings or Gloom release and does not broaden the pre-existing BAN interfaces.
commonRules.custody: Every item has one stable identity, provenance, current holder or ground location, weight, Load and independent deadline. Living bodies, corpses and source-ended absent entities are distinct. Mandatory anatomy/source endings happen first; never delay an expiry to preserve a convenient shape or manufacture a corpse. A generated space supplies only expressly authored floor/boundaries/light/respiration support; no harvestable matter, permanent supplies, inhabitants, treasure, immunity, protected rest, native status, soul rule or automatic Extraction. Preserve cargo danger, taint, claims and Hunt records. Once initiated, Hunt death is normally final except the owner’s extremely rare Divine/Abyssal exception; none of these spells grants that exception.
commonRules.qualification: Static proposed authorship and data-only fixtures are not game execution or observed campaign results. Real actor acquisition, creature profiles, destination geometry, native/cosmology facts, environmental needs and equipment not established by a source remain explicit whole-case/branch holds. No runtime, human-play, balance, cosmology or release approval. All closed feat335, completed16/72 and applied spell cohorts remain closed.

localRules.admission: NEW: select one perceived actual creature within120ft/line of effect. WIS save against the actual class-school DC; ACCEPT may voluntarily fail, RESIST rolls. On failure and a free hard-control gate, displace that body and actual gear into its own generated labyrinth. No unselected carried passenger is silently banished; detach only if independently legal, otherwise the component fails. NEW concentration, maximum60 elapsed seconds from establishment; original Instantaneous remains untouched. One Maze per caster via concentration and one active Maze per primary target. Known active primary or target absent behind planar opacity is invalid preflight, not a refresh. Starting a legal new concentrated spell ends an old concentration before interruption; no refund or restoration.
localRules.topology: NEW: use the exact finite16-node tree in MAZE_TOPOLOGY.json. For the current body footprint width/depth b and height h, module size L=5*ceil((max(b,width,depth)+10)/5); clear corridor width L-5, ceiling H=5*ceil((h+5)/5), room clear width L-0.5. Nodes are centers (L*(x+0.5),L*(y+0.5),0), x/y=0..3. Open listed edges have a centered corridor of width L-5 through each intervening wall; closed edges and exterior boundary are opaque0.5ft-thick spell walls. Accepted grid-metric ordinary movement applies, adjacent center distance L. Entry=(0,0), exit=(3,3). The cast ID and target ID are the stable seed; this revision intentionally uses the same fixed base topology for every seed, recorded unchanged (no random rotation or private reroll). Actual light reveals only ordinary unobstructed sight, not an automatic map. No regeneration invalidates explored routes. Wall material cannot be harvested or conventionally broken; actual independently legal matter/space effects require an explicit scope rather than assumed universal immunity or passage.
localRules.escape: At the actual exit node, the primary may spend an Action touching the visible exit to end the Maze. Normal movement costs/budgets and visibility apply; there is no imported Intelligence roll, species privilege or extra action. Any actual independent lawful exit by the primary also ends it. A supported floor and sustaining medium preserve existing respiration; no safe-rest or immunity promise. Exact unavailable environmental/body needs are held. A same-plane Dimensional Door cannot cross to the original plane; ordinary True Seeing does not erase physical walls. A proved actual Faction Portal or other source may work only with its own access, legal destination, standing and body predicates.
localRules.lifecycle: Concentration loss, deadline, actual suppression of the Maze application, successful perceived-effect dispel, primary death, primary source expiry or a mandatory anatomy that exceeds existing clearance all end this application once. Distant caster suppression alone does not reach it. Ended primaries remain absent; corpses remain dead. P5-CLOSE settles each remaining visitor, corpse and object once. The geometry is never extended just to keep confinement. Secondary visitors require their own exact source/geometry/knowledge and anchor at entry, retain their own source lifetimes and do not automatically become maze primaries. No one gains control of them or free creature content. Persistent placement conflict is external and cannot extend Maze beyond60seconds.

commonRules.native: Each native card, Core entry, book placement and class-access row is copied unchanged below. commonRules.preflight: Use an actually acquired and prepared matrix or an exact class permission. Check remaining Action, usable voice, free gesturing hand and actual focus, rank/RP, target identity, actual range and unobstructed line of effect. A known invalid declaration is rejected before payment. Missing authoritative physical/source prerequisites put the dependent case on hold; a held test is not a successful or paid cast. A lawful declaration defeated only by hidden facts spends its committed costs and produces no diagnostic locating or classifying the hidden fact. Revalidate each component at effect resolution. No retargeting or refund on failure.
commonRules.commit: Commit RP, components, source-history and concentration before interruption/save. Cost is 21 plus the exact pre-cast Dissonance surcharge and printed extras only. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); +1 at limit, +2 at limit+3, ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. First distinct actual Wizard prepared family gives zero BASE strain only; otherwise rank8 base strain is 2. Consecutive same-family Refrain adds 1/2/3 capped at3, idle turns do not reset it. No class perk is assumed without acquisition. An interrupted or resisted cast retains costs and never restores displaced concentration. Exact legal Counterspell/Dispel sources keep their own ranks/costs/checks; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/check INT+PB versus18 for rank8, not rank5 Greater Dispel.
commonRules.timing: Use actual elapsed seconds; generated spaces have 1:1 time. An expiry at timestamp t occurs before a newly beginning action at t; already committed atomic crossings finish before an external closure event can settle them. Ordinary Ready commits at preparation, uses held concentration, releases once with a remaining Reaction after its completed trigger, and expires at the next own regular START. Release does not pay/cast/update cadence again; effect deadlines begin on release. A continuing effect retains concentration normally after release. No extra regular START, recharge, rest, recovery, Refrain reset, Hunt pause or resource refresh is created by moving planes.
commonRules.transport: Creation of a room/cell is not itself body travel. Door creation is a connection; its use is physical planar crossing. Maze, Seal of Banishment and Gloom Bind admissions are planar displacement, not teleportation. Record ACCEPT versus RESIST separately from save result. Voluntary or forced travel restrictions use their exact predicates, not a generic planar tag. Every creature is separate from gear, including carried unconscious allies, mounts and summons. Check whole-body geometry and actual custody for each. No splitting, duplicating inventories, body-as-cargo target-cap bypass or unprovided portal provider. Record current plane, actual travel provenance, origin anchor and source-character identity separately from native realm, which may remain unknown.
commonRules.hardControl: Maze, each Seal of Banishment child and Gloom Bind count as encounter-removal/hard denial and require the shared source-character/target/encounter gate across all that source character’s spells, classes and companions. Spend the gate only on actual establishment, not a resisted or preflight-rejected cast. Prior expenditure or a proved immunity prevents only the applicable control; no new target or refund. No nesting or refresh bypass. Record actual save ability, bonus, DC, die and any chosen lawful reaction/reroll; no generic monster save profile is invented.
commonRules.closureExtension: NEW P5-CLOSE extension applies ONLY to true Demiplane room removal, Maze termination and Seal of Banishment child termination. It explicitly reuses BAN-CLOSE-03, BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03 and BAN-CONFLICT-04: end the source first, settle every extant identity exactly once to its fixed origin plane/anchor (secondary occupants project their local offset onto the recorded entry/creation anchor), ignore ONLY transport-prevention at the terminal endpoints. Try full body at anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral order (south, west, east, north, then SW, SE, NW, NE on the declared grid). Never pass a wall/occupied space or search farther. If none fits, retain a logical-anchor placementConflict with no fabricated footprint, support, falling, movement or new actions; independently legal actions and clocks continue. Normalize only when obstruction is actually removed or lawful relocation resolves it. Loose items retain pending placement/custody, never disappear. Source has ended even while conflict remains. This exception does not permit voluntary entry, internal escape, new portal crossings or Gloom release and does not broaden the pre-existing BAN interfaces.
commonRules.custody: Every item has one stable identity, provenance, current holder or ground location, weight, Load and independent deadline. Living bodies, corpses and source-ended absent entities are distinct. Mandatory anatomy/source endings happen first; never delay an expiry to preserve a convenient shape or manufacture a corpse. A generated space supplies only expressly authored floor/boundaries/light/respiration support; no harvestable matter, permanent supplies, inhabitants, treasure, immunity, protected rest, native status, soul rule or automatic Extraction. Preserve cargo danger, taint, claims and Hunt records. Once initiated, Hunt death is normally final except the owner’s extremely rare Divine/Abyssal exception; none of these spells grants that exception.
commonRules.qualification: Static proposed authorship and data-only fixtures are not game execution or observed campaign results. Real actor acquisition, creature profiles, destination geometry, native/cosmology facts, environmental needs and equipment not established by a source remain explicit whole-case/branch holds. No runtime, human-play, balance, cosmology or release approval. All closed feat335, completed16/72 and applied spell cohorts remain closed.

localRules.predicate: NEW P5-EXTRAPLANAR applies only to this spell: affirmatively qualifies an actual creature with an explicit operative extraplanar source flag, or a recorded most recent successful cross-plane body arrival from a different plane into its current plane. A source-created body also qualifies only if that source explicitly proves foreign-planar provenance. localRules.cells: NEW concentration and a60-second parent deadline from resolution; each successful target owns an independent generated BAN-CELL-03 cell, expressly extending its finite body+clearance topology/support/agency and BAN-ADMIT-03 only to these children. localRules.endings: Each child ends independently on actual application suppression, a successful perceived-effect dispel, primary death/source expiry or actual lawful primary departure. Reduce the spell to an observer-private illusion or import an unstated external Maze rule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain real labyrinth displacement and actual agency, preserving both placements and current class-school access. GPT must select NEW save/automatic admission choice, concentration and finite maximum; encounter-removal uses the accepted hard-control gate only where explicitly applicable.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The labyrinth promise requires a real navigable challenge, but no topology, dimensions, exit condition, INT check or automatic species escape is printed.
options: Define deterministic generated topology/seed and a finite ordinary navigation/escape procedure, including small and large bodies.
Use an abstract roll that makes the labyrinth irrelevant or silently give named creatures automatic escape.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend an executable finite labyrinth with explicit passages, whole-body fit, movement and escape interaction; any check costs, DC, cadence or species privilege are NEW. No regeneration may invalidate visited routes without a stated rule. Preserve meaningful choices and actual action costs.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No printed rule describes freedom, source suppression, concentration loss, death, corpses, later visitors or expiry inside Maze.
options: Specify a complete closure/escape lifecycle and real body/object placement with bounded source-specific exceptions.
Leave permanent sealed survivors or reuse Banishment’s exceptions without review.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend define terminal return/anchor and settlement for every genuine occupant and object, preserving escaped identities, deaths, source expiry and carried creatures. A source ending never duplicates lost gear or revives a dead target; physical conflict cannot silently extend the effect.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual Dimensional Door is same-plane only; Faction Portal may reach a qualifying real headquarters on another plane; accepted True Seeing distinguishes subjective mental effects from physical geometry.
options: Apply each actual escape, information and suppression source by its exact predicate; a real maze remains physically real.
Let True Seeing universally dispel it or assume every teleport escapes it.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit access/knowledge/range/plane/body checks. Keep Maze distinct from accepted Mind Maze and Mental Prison. A named school does not make real walls false or grant immunity. Resolve suppression of target, connection and source separately.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source does not specify recasting on an absent target, independent prisoners, shared labyrinths or concurrent caster ownership.
options: Choose one bounded application/space policy with actual perceived targets and original clocks.
Allow hidden absent-target selection, unlimited nested realms or recast-based imprisonment refresh.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend stable per-application identity, explicit replacement/nesting handling and no free target knowledge. Disclose whether separate captives ever share space and how visitors create closure metadata; decide without revising canonical realm identity.

options: Select one actual plane identity plus a fixed local one-mile region, explicitly reconciling120ft placement range.
Treat one mile as target range, silently reduce ALL to one portal, or close all planes.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend NEW fixed spherical area centered on a legally placed point within120ft, with whole-connection endpoint predicates stated. Include inaccessible/hidden connections without granting a locator. An undefined plane name fails designation without inventing identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual portals, Planar Window, exile cells and long-term compulsion have distinct crossing/information/source relationships. Close connections does not define what counts.
options: Define an exact connection taxonomy and apply ALL qualifying connections to the selected plane; distinguish existing effects from ongoing links.
End every spell involving a planar creature or classify only visible doorways.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend decide real transit apertures, scrying windows, telepathy or persistent summon tethers individually from actual sources. Do not unsummon a body merely because it previously arrived, sever a soul, erase an existing plane or promote every sustained effect into a connection.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The verb close and Instantaneous can mean a one-time closure; a continuing prohibition against new connections would be new power.
options: One-time atomic closure of qualifying existing connections; later independent opening remains possible.
A separately authored continuing seal with explicit duration, concentration and reopening limits.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend one-time closure unless joint review chooses and labels a finite ongoing ward. Preserve the full one-mile/all-connections benefit. Do not accidentally turn instantaneous closure into permanent global prevention or silently pause independent clocks.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Closing during a genuine transit or exile ending can strand, split or delete bodies unless ordering is explicit; ordinary Ready resolves after its completed trigger.
options: Finish committed atomic crossings, then close later use; explicitly adjudicate true interruption sources and mandatory endings.
Bisect a body or convert ordinary Ready into a mid-transit interrupt.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend deterministic event order, source-specific terminal settlement and exact metadata retention. Decide whether a terminal Banishment return is a sealable connection or a scoped mandatory transition; do not imply the spell inherits or overrides its exception silently.

options: Explicitly select a source-local extraplanar predicate and preserve missing/hidden qualification behavior.

questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend persistent same-identity binding until a real selected ending; explicitly distinguish source suppression from true dispel. Specify actual-caster death, replacement, travel blockers and remaining occupants/cargo without deleting the binding’s history or inventing a free round trip.

options: Keep the actual living/dead body, source lifetime and independent Hunt/recovery rules; no soul relocation is inferred.
Treat exile as death, rewrite origin/soul identity, or create a repeatable Hunt escape.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend preserve all real HP/death/research/taint/source records and inventory provenance.
